placements.title: Public cycling kit goes where riders break down and is secured where kit goes missing
placements.frame: Where does the evidence of actual rider need or past loss say this public cycling facility, or its equipment, should be placed or protected?
placements.why: Nothing in the graph covers public cycling infrastructure. The position pairs two statements, both arguing that the repair stand's siting and security should follow observed local behaviour: where the flats happen, and where the last pump was stolen. This is a subject future envelopes about public facilities could keep feeding, not a one-time fact. The graph's two existing leaves, ferry sailings and tool-library hours, are structurally similar in shape but concern other subjects, so reusing either would be word-shape overlap only. It stands alone as a new region.
